claim-decapod-one-release.statement: AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, CODEX.md, GEMINI.md and Dockerfile.decapod pin Decapod 0.121.1, and the CI workflow installs the release that the AGENTS.md header names.
claim-decapod-one-release.falsifier: Any entrypoint header or Dockerfile ARG names another release, or decapod-validate.yml installs decapod without the version from the AGENTS.md header.

claim-readiness-contract.statement: .decapod/config.toml declares repo.pr-readiness.v1 with the required commands fmt (alejandra --check) and shellcheck, and agent.init reports the contract reconciled.
claim-readiness-contract.falsifier: agent.init reports REPOSITORY_CONTRACT_INVALID or MISSING_REQUIRED_PROFILE, or a required command is missing.
